package db

// Generator for #718 prototype-2 legacy-step fixtures. Drives the real v1.39.17
// per-shard migration code (ReindexProvider.createReindexTasks, then the same
// RunReindexOnlyOnShard / RunPrepareOnShard / RunSwapOnShard calls the
// provider's phase callbacks make, then a real shard load for promotion), and
// copies each shard directory out as tar.gz + manifest.json.
//
// Run: Q718V2_FIXTURE_OUT=<dir> go test -v -count=1 -run TestQ718v2GenerateLegacyFixtures ./adapters/repos/db

import (
	"archive/tar"
	"compress/gzip"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"testing"

	"github.com/go-openapi/strfmt"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/sirupsen/logrus/hooks/test"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/weaviate/weaviate/adapters/repos/db/lsmkv"
	"github.com/weaviate/weaviate/cluster/distributedtask"
	"github.com/weaviate/weaviate/entities/additional"
	"github.com/weaviate/weaviate/entities/filters"
	"github.com/weaviate/weaviate/entities/models"
	"github.com/weaviate/weaviate/entities/schema"
	"github.com/weaviate/weaviate/entities/searchparams"
	enthnsw "github.com/weaviate/weaviate/entities/vectorindex/hnsw"
)

const (
	q718Prop      = "title"
	q718Equal     = "hello world"
	q718TaskID    = "q718-legacy-fixture"
	q718NodeName  = "node1"
	q718TenantRef = "foo-tenant" // the multi-tenant test helper's only tenant
)

// 5 x "hello world", 3 x "hello there world", 2 x "world hello".
// word tokenization: Equal "hello world" matches all 10 (both tokens), BM25 "hello" 10.
// field tokenization: Equal "hello world" matches 5 (exact value), BM25 "hello" 0, BM25 "hello world" 5.
var q718Values = func() []string {
	var out []string
	for i := 0; i < 5; i++ {
		out = append(out, "hello world")
	}
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		out = append(out, "hello there world")
	}
	for i := 0; i < 2; i++ {
		out = append(out, "world hello")
	}
	return out
}()

type q718Stop string

const (
	q718StopIterated q718Stop = "iterated"
	q718StopMerged   q718Stop = "merged"
	q718StopSwapped  q718Stop = "swapped"
	q718StopPromoted q718Stop = "promoted"
)

type q718Counts struct {
	EqualHelloWorld int `json:"filterEqual_title_hello_world"`
	BM25Hello       int `json:"bm25_title_hello"`
	BM25HelloWorld  int `json:"bm25_title_hello_world"`
}

type q718Case struct {
	name  string
	mtype ReindexMigrationType
	// blockmax: the class starts with blockmax searchable buckets.
	blockmax bool
	stop     q718Stop
	// effectShown: the class at upgrade shows the migration's effect.
	effectShown bool
	// promoteStatus: task status the v1.39.17 load that promotes the record sees.
	promoteStatus distributedtask.TaskStatus
	// precedingFailedRun: a failed earlier run (task version 1) left an iterated record first.
	precedingFailedRun bool
	how                string
	expected           q718Counts
	expectedNote       string
}

func q718Class(className string, blockmax bool) *models.Class {
	return &models.Class{
		Class:              className,
		VectorIndexConfig:  enthnsw.NewDefaultUserConfig(),
		MultiTenancyConfig: &models.MultiTenancyConfig{Enabled: true},
		InvertedIndexConfig: &models.InvertedIndexConfig{
			CleanupIntervalSeconds: 60,
			Stopwords:              &models.StopwordConfig{Preset: "none"},
			IndexNullState:         true,
			IndexPropertyLength:    true,
			UsingBlockMaxWAND:      blockmax,
		},
		Properties: []*models.Property{{
			Name:            q718Prop,
			DataType:        schema.DataTypeText.PropString(),
			Tokenization:    models.PropertyTokenizationWord,
			IndexFilterable: boolPtr(true),
			IndexSearchable: boolPtr(true),
		}},
	}
}

// The class as the schema holds it once the migration's flip landed.
func q718ApplyEffect(class *models.Class, mtype ReindexMigrationType) {
	prop := class.Properties[0]
	switch mtype {
	case ReindexTypeChangeTokenization:
		prop.Tokenization = models.PropertyTokenizationField
	case ReindexTypeChangeAlgorithm:
		// stampSearchableBlockmax, then the class flag (one searchable property, so not deferred).
		prop.SearchableBlockmax = boolPtr(true)
		class.InvertedIndexConfig.UsingBlockMaxWAND = true
	case ReindexTypeRebuildSearchable:
		// No setting changes.
	}
}

func q718Payload(class *models.Class, mtype ReindexMigrationType, unitID, shardName string) *ReindexTaskPayload {
	p := &ReindexTaskPayload{
		MigrationType: mtype,
		Collection:    class.Class,
		Properties:    []string{q718Prop},
		Tenants:       []string{shardName},
		UnitToNode:    map[string]string{unitID: q718NodeName},
		UnitToShard:   map[string]string{unitID: shardName},
	}
	if mtype == ReindexTypeChangeTokenization {
		p.TargetTokenization = models.PropertyTokenizationField
		p.OriginalTokenization = models.PropertyTokenizationWord
		// As the submit handler picks it (handlers_reindex.go validateTokenizationChange).
		p.BucketStrategy = lsmkv.DefaultSearchableStrategy(SearchablePropertyIsBlockmax(class, q718Prop))
	}
	return p
}

func q718Count(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, s *Shard, className string) q718Counts {
	t.Helper()
	res, _, err := s.ObjectSearch(ctx, 100, &filters.LocalFilter{Root: &filters.Clause{
		Operator: filters.OperatorEqual,
		On:       &filters.Path{Class: schema.ClassName(className), Property: q718Prop},
		Value:    &filters.Value{Value: q718Equal, Type: schema.DataTypeText},
	}}, nil, nil, nil, additional.Properties{}, nil)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	bm25 := func(q string) int {
		r, _, err := s.ObjectSearch(ctx, 100, nil, &searchparams.KeywordRanking{
			Type: "bm25", Properties: []string{q718Prop}, Query: q,
		}, nil, nil, additional.Properties{}, nil)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		return len(r)
	}
	return q718Counts{EqualHelloWorld: len(res), BM25Hello: bm25("hello"), BM25HelloWorld: bm25("hello world")}
}

func q718Tasks(t *testing.T, p *ReindexProvider, version uint64, unitID string, payload *ReindexTaskPayload,
) []*ShardReindexTaskGeneric {
	t.Helper()
	tasks, err := p.createReindexTasks(distributedtask.TaskDescriptor{ID: q718TaskID, Version: version}, unitID, payload)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotEmpty(t, tasks)
	return tasks
}

func q718Drive(t *testing.T, ctx context.Context, tasks []*ShardReindexTaskGeneric, shard *Shard, stop q718Stop) {
	t.Helper()
	for _, task := range tasks {
		require.NoError(t, task.RunReindexOnlyOnShard(ctx, shard), task.Name())
	}
	if stop == q718StopIterated {
		return
	}
	for _, task := range tasks {
		require.NoError(t, task.RunPrepareOnShard(ctx, shard), task.Name())
	}
	if stop == q718StopMerged {
		return
	}
	for _, task := range tasks {
		require.NoError(t, task.RunSwapOnShard(ctx, shard), task.Name())
	}
}

func q718SetLocalTasks(idx *Index, entries []distributedtask.TaskStatusEntry, readable bool) {
	idx.db.migrationCluster.local = func(string) ([]distributedtask.TaskStatusEntry, bool) { return entries, readable }
}

func TestQ718v2GenerateLegacyFixtures(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("Q718V2_FIXTURE_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("Q718V2_FIXTURE_OUT not set")
	}
	word := q718Counts{EqualHelloWorld: 10, BM25Hello: 10, BM25HelloWorld: 10}
	field := q718Counts{EqualHelloWorld: 5, BM25Hello: 0, BM25HelloWorld: 10 - 5}
	unchanged := word

	cases := []q718Case{
		// --- change-tokenization word -> field: changes a setting ---
		{
			name: "01-changetok-swapped-effect-shown", mtype: ReindexTypeChangeTokenization, blockmax: true,
			stop: q718StopSwapped, effectShown: true,
			how: "Run reached the swap on this tenant (record swapped), shard shut down / unloaded before any further load, " +
				"then the task FINISHED and the tokenization flip landed. v1.39.17 promotes only at shard load " +
				"(shard_init.go:160 -> inverted_reindex_shard_wiring.go:35), so on disk the record stays swapped. " +
				"NOTE: the swap itself already deleted the plain (old, word) folders (inverted_reindex_task_generic.go:1258-1276, " +
				"'displaced directory'); the staged folders are the only copy.",
			expected: field,
		},
		{
			name: "02-changetok-swapped-effect-not-shown", mtype: ReindexTypeChangeTokenization, blockmax: true,
			stop: q718StopSwapped, effectShown: false,
			how: "Failed partial run: this tenant's group was decided (swapped), then the task FAILED, so the class never flipped. " +
				"Terminal cleanup never discards a flip-decided record (inverted_reindex_reconcile.go DiscardTask skips FlipDecided).",
			expected: field,
			expectedNote: "CONFLICT: the class says word, but the swap deleted the plain (word) folders " +
				"(inverted_reindex_task_generic.go:1258-1276); the staged folders hold the only copy, field-tokenized. " +
				"v1.39.17 serves field for this tenant through the record's overlay (load_overlay.go:39-55, failed task -> overrides). " +
				"Listed counts = what v1.39.17 serves. The planned rule (class does not show effect -> delete staged) deletes the " +
				"only copy of this property's filterable and searchable index: data loss.",
		},
		{
			name: "03-changetok-promoted-effect-shown", mtype: ReindexTypeChangeTokenization, blockmax: true,
			stop: q718StopPromoted, effectShown: true, promoteStatus: distributedtask.TaskStatusSwapping,
			how: "Swapped, then the shard was loaded once more while the task was still SWAPPING (promotion renamed the staged " +
				"folders onto the plain names, record -> promoted), then the flip landed with no later load. " +
				"The record is only removed by a load that sees the effect (reconcilePromotedSealed).",
			expected: field,
		},
		{
			name: "04-changetok-promoted-effect-not-shown", mtype: ReindexTypeChangeTokenization, blockmax: true,
			stop: q718StopPromoted, effectShown: false, promoteStatus: distributedtask.TaskStatusFailed,
			how: "Failed partial run, tenant swapped, then loaded: v1.39.17 promotes regardless of task status " +
				"(reconcileSwapped has no verdict) and keeps the record because it overrides the schema " +
				"(inverted_reindex_load_overlay.go:39-55: failed task -> true). The word-tokenized data was deleted by the swap.",
			expected: field,
			expectedNote: "CONFLICT: the class says word, but the plain folders hold field-tokenized data and the word data is gone " +
				"(deleted at the swap, task_generic.go:1258-1276). v1.39.17 serves field for this tenant via the record's overlay. " +
				"The listed counts are what v1.39.17 serves (field). If the new code follows the class (word) with this data, " +
				"Equal 'hello world' returns 0 and BM25 'hello' returns 0.",
		},
		{
			name: "05-changetok-merged-not-switched", mtype: ReindexTypeChangeTokenization, blockmax: true,
			stop: q718StopMerged, effectShown: false,
			how: "Run failed or was cancelled after this tenant merged but before its swap; the tenant was COLD/unloaded during " +
				"terminal cleanup, which skips unmapped tenants (reindex_provider.go:1742-1755, sweep doc ~1790).",
			expected: word,
		},
		{
			name: "06-changetok-iterated-not-switched", mtype: ReindexTypeChangeTokenization, blockmax: true,
			stop: q718StopIterated, effectShown: false,
			how:  "As 05, but the run died before prepare: record iterated, staged folders hold the rebuilt data.",
			expected: word,
		},
		{
			name: "07-changetok-iterated-v1-plus-swapped-v2-effect-shown", mtype: ReindexTypeChangeTokenization, blockmax: true,
			stop: q718StopSwapped, effectShown: true, precedingFailedRun: true,
			how: "Attempt at a not-switched record WITH effect shown: run v1 (task version 1) left iterated records on this tenant " +
				"and its task was GC'd; a load with v1's task gone leaves them (verdictFrom: taskListMayLag -> Leave). Run v2 of the " +
				"same change then swapped this tenant and FINISHED. RESULT: v2's swap retired v1's records and folders " +
				"(RetireSuperseded, inverted_reindex_task_generic.go:1250), so the cell collapses to 01 with task version 2.",
			expected: field,
		},
		// --- rebuild-searchable: changes no setting ---
		{
			name: "08-rebuildsearchable-swapped", mtype: ReindexTypeRebuildSearchable, blockmax: true,
			stop: q718StopSwapped,
			how:  "Swapped, not reloaded since. Effect never observable (schema_effect.go: nil reader), so shown/not-shown is one cell.",
			expected: unchanged,
		},
		{
			name: "09-rebuildsearchable-promoted", mtype: ReindexTypeRebuildSearchable, blockmax: true,
			stop: q718StopPromoted, promoteStatus: distributedtask.TaskStatusStarted,
			how:  "Swapped, then loaded once while the task was still running (record promoted); no later load.",
			expected: unchanged,
		},
		{
			name: "10-rebuildsearchable-iterated-not-switched", mtype: ReindexTypeRebuildSearchable, blockmax: true,
			stop: q718StopIterated,
			how:  "Run failed/cancelled before this tenant's swap; tenant unloaded during cleanup.",
			expected: unchanged,
		},
		// --- change-algorithm (map -> blockmax): v1.39.17 stamps searchableBlockmax, so it DOES change a setting ---
		{
			name: "11-changealgo-swapped-effect-shown", mtype: ReindexTypeChangeAlgorithm, blockmax: false,
			stop: q718StopSwapped, effectShown: true,
			how:  "Swapped, unloaded, task FINISHED: searchableBlockmax stamped and class usingBlockMaxWAND flipped.",
			expected: unchanged,
		},
		{
			name: "12-changealgo-swapped-effect-not-shown", mtype: ReindexTypeChangeAlgorithm, blockmax: false,
			stop: q718StopSwapped, effectShown: false,
			how:  "Failed partial run: tenant swapped, task FAILED, no stamp.",
			expected: unchanged,
			expectedNote: "CONFLICT: the class says map (no searchableBlockmax), but the swap deleted the plain map-format searchable " +
				"folder; the staged blockmax folder is the only copy. v1.39.17 serves it through the record's overlay (counts listed). " +
				"The planned rule (class does not show effect -> delete staged) leaves no searchable index: BM25 returns 0 or the load fails.",
		},
		{
			name: "13-changealgo-merged-not-switched", mtype: ReindexTypeChangeAlgorithm, blockmax: false,
			stop: q718StopMerged, effectShown: false,
			how:  "Run failed/cancelled before this tenant's swap.",
			expected: unchanged,
		},
	}

	for _, tc := range cases {
		t.Run(tc.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			q718GenerateOne(t, out, tc)
		})
	}
}

func q718GenerateOne(t *testing.T, outRoot string, tc q718Case) {
	ctx := testCtx()
	className := "Q718Legacy"
	class := q718Class(className, tc.blockmax)
	shd, idx := testShardWithMultiTenantSettings(t, ctx, class, enthnsw.UserConfig{Skip: true}, true, false, false)
	shard := shd.(*Shard)
	shardName, lsm, shardDir := shard.Name(), shard.pathLSM(), shard.path()
	require.Equal(t, q718TenantRef, shardName)
	unitID := shard.migrationUnit()

	type objRow struct {
		ID    string `json:"id"`
		Title string `json:"title"`
	}
	var objs []objRow
	for i, v := range q718Values {
		id := uuid.NewSHA1(uuid.NameSpaceOID, []byte(fmt.Sprintf("q718-%d", i))).String()
		obj := createTestObjectWithText(className, v)
		obj.Object.ID = strfmt.UUID(id)
		require.NoError(t, shard.PutObject(ctx, obj))
		objs = append(objs, objRow{ID: id, Title: v})
	}
	baseline := q718Count(t, ctx, shard, className)
	require.Equal(t, q718Counts{EqualHelloWorld: 10, BM25Hello: 10, BM25HelloWorld: 10}, baseline, "word baseline")

	p := NewReindexProvider(idx.db, nil, nil, idx.logger, q718NodeName, nil, ctx)
	version := uint64(1)
	if tc.precedingFailedRun {
		v1 := q718Tasks(t, p, 1, unitID, q718Payload(class, tc.mtype, unitID, shardName))
		q718Drive(t, ctx, v1, shard, q718StopIterated)
		require.NoError(t, shard.Shutdown(ctx))
		simulateProcessRestartBucketCleanup(t, lsm)
		// v1's task is gone from this node's list and the effect is not visible: the load leaves the record.
		q718SetLocalTasks(idx, nil, true)
		shard = openShardFromDisk(t, ctx, idx, class, shardName)
		for _, st := range migrationRecordStates(t, lsm) {
			require.Equal(t, MigrationStateIterated, st)
		}
		version = 2
	}

	tasks := q718Tasks(t, p, version, unitID, q718Payload(class, tc.mtype, unitID, shardName))
	driveTo := tc.stop
	if driveTo == q718StopPromoted {
		driveTo = q718StopSwapped
	}
	q718Drive(t, ctx, tasks, shard, driveTo)
	require.NoError(t, shard.Shutdown(ctx))
	simulateProcessRestartBucketCleanup(t, lsm)

	if tc.stop == q718StopPromoted {
		// The one v1.39.17 load between the swap and the upgrade; the class is still pre-flip.
		q718SetLocalTasks(idx, []distributedtask.TaskStatusEntry{{
			TaskDescriptor: distributedtask.TaskDescriptor{ID: q718TaskID, Version: version},
			Status:         tc.promoteStatus, GroupDecided: true, PrepAckedBy: []string{q718NodeName},
		}}, true)
		shard = openShardFromDisk(t, ctx, idx, class, shardName)
		require.NoError(t, shard.Shutdown(ctx))
		simulateProcessRestartBucketCleanup(t, lsm)
	}

	upgradeClass := q718Class(className, tc.blockmax)
	if tc.effectShown {
		q718ApplyEffect(upgradeClass, tc.mtype)
	}

	// ---- capture ----
	dir := filepath.Join(outRoot, tc.name)
	require.NoError(t, os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755))
	tarPath := filepath.Join(dir, "shard.tar.gz")
	require.NoError(t, q718Tar(shardDir, tarPath))

	records := q718Records(t, lsm)
	gotStates := make([]string, 0, len(records))
	for _, r := range records {
		gotStates = append(gotStates, r.State)
	}
	t.Logf("%s: record states %v", tc.name, gotStates)

	lsmEntries := q718LsmDirs(t, lsm)
	files := q718Files(t, shardDir)

	// ---- what v1.39.17 itself serves after one more load with the upgrade-time class ----
	// (destroys nothing captured: the tarball is already written)
	status := distributedtask.TaskStatusFinished
	if !tc.effectShown && tc.mtype != ReindexTypeRebuildSearchable {
		status = distributedtask.TaskStatusFailed
	}
	if tc.mtype == ReindexTypeRebuildSearchable {
		status = distributedtask.TaskStatusFinished
		if tc.stop == q718StopIterated {
			status = distributedtask.TaskStatusFailed
		}
	}
	switched := tc.stop == q718StopSwapped || tc.stop == q718StopPromoted
	q718SetLocalTasks(idx, []distributedtask.TaskStatusEntry{{
		TaskDescriptor: distributedtask.TaskDescriptor{ID: q718TaskID, Version: version},
		Status:         status, GroupDecided: switched, PrepAckedBy: []string{q718NodeName},
	}}, true)
	// The index's schema getter holds `class` by pointer, so the flip is applied to it in place.
	if tc.effectShown {
		q718ApplyEffect(class, tc.mtype)
	}
	require.NoError(t, idx.updateProperty(ctx, class.Properties[0]))
	loaded := openShardFromDisk(t, ctx, idx, class, shardName)
	v13917 := q718Count(t, ctx, loaded, className)
	v13917States := migrationRecordStates(t, lsm)
	require.NoError(t, loaded.Shutdown(ctx))
	simulateProcessRestartBucketCleanup(t, lsm)
	t.Logf("%s: v1.39.17 after one more load (task %s): %+v, records after: %v", tc.name, status, v13917, v13917States)

	classJSON, err := json.Marshal(upgradeClass)
	require.NoError(t, err)

	manifest := map[string]any{
		"generatedBy":    "v1.39.17 (7fd11ac128) adapters/repos/db TestQ718v2GenerateLegacyFixtures",
		"fixture":        tc.name,
		"migrationType":  tc.mtype,
		"howV13917GotHere": tc.how,
		"recordStateAtUpgrade": tc.stop,
		"effectShownByClass":   tc.effectShown,
		"classAtUpgrade":       json.RawMessage(classJSON),
		"tenant":               shardName,
		"shardDirName":         filepath.Base(shardDir),
		"nodeName":             q718NodeName,
		"unitID":               unitID,
		"taskID":               q718TaskID,
		"taskVersion":          version,
		"objectCount":          len(objs),
		"objects":              objs,
		"records":              records,
		"lsmTopLevelDirs":      lsmEntries,
		"files":                files,
		"tarball":              "shard.tar.gz (root entry = shard directory, i.e. <indexDir>/" + filepath.Base(shardDir) + ")",
		"queries": map[string]string{
			"filterEqual_title_hello_world": "where title Equal \"hello world\" (valueText)",
			"bm25_title_hello":              "bm25 query \"hello\" on title",
			"bm25_title_hello_world":        "bm25 query \"hello world\" on title",
		},
		"expectedOnNewCode":      map[string]any{shardName: tc.expected},
		"expectedNote":           tc.expectedNote,
		"v13917AfterOneMoreLoad": map[string]any{"taskStatusSeen": status, "counts": v13917, "recordStatesAfter": v13917States},
		"baselineBeforeMigration": baseline,
	}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(manifest, "", "  ")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NoError(t, os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "manifest.json"), data, 0o644))
}

type q718Record struct {
	File    string          `json:"file"`
	State   string          `json:"state"`
	Decoded json.RawMessage `json:"decoded"`
}

func q718Records(t *testing.T, lsm string) []q718Record {
	t.Helper()
	logger, _ := test.NewNullLogger()
	store := NewMigrationRecordStore(lsm, logger)
	require.NoError(t, store.Load())
	require.Empty(t, store.Unreadable())
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(store.Dir())
	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return nil
	}
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var out []q718Record
	for _, e := range entries {
		if e.IsDir() {
			continue
		}
		raw, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(store.Dir(), e.Name()))
		require.NoError(t, err)
		rec, err := decodeMigrationRecord(raw)
		require.NoError(t, err, e.Name())
		out = append(out, q718Record{File: filepath.Join(migrationsDir, migrationRecordsDirName, e.Name()), State: string(rec.State()), Decoded: raw})
	}
	return out
}

func q718LsmDirs(t *testing.T, lsm string) []string {
	t.Helper()
	entries, err := os.ReadDir(lsm)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	var out []string
	for _, e := range entries {
		if e.IsDir() {
			out = append(out, e.Name())
		}
	}
	sort.Strings(out)
	return out
}

func q718Files(t *testing.T, root string) []string {
	t.Helper()
	var out []string
	require.NoError(t, filepath.WalkDir(root, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		rel, err := filepath.Rel(root, path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if d.IsDir() {
			out = append(out, rel+"/")
			return nil
		}
		info, err := d.Info()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		out = append(out, fmt.Sprintf("%s (%d B)", rel, info.Size()))
		return nil
	}))
	return out
}

func q718Tar(srcDir, dst string) error {
	f, err := os.Create(dst)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer f.Close()
	gz := gzip.NewWriter(f)
	tw := tar.NewWriter(gz)
	base := filepath.Dir(srcDir)
	walkErr := filepath.WalkDir(srcDir, func(path string, d fs.DirEntry, err error) error {
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		info, err := d.Info()
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		rel, err := filepath.Rel(base, path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		hdr, err := tar.FileInfoHeader(info, "")
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		hdr.Name = filepath.ToSlash(rel)
		if d.IsDir() {
			hdr.Name += "/"
		}
		if err := tw.WriteHeader(hdr); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
			return nil
		}
		src, err := os.Open(path)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		defer src.Close()
		_, err = io.Copy(tw, src)
		return err
	})
	if walkErr != nil {
		return walkErr
	}
	if err := tw.Close(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := gz.Close(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return f.Close()
}
